title: The agent writes something deterministic and generally useful, and offers it
rationale: Without capture the registry only ever shrinks relative to demand. This is the loop closing.
recordedFrom: CapFoundry.text.editDistance entered the registry this way on 2026-09-12: a session asked for edit distance, CFCM had nothing, the agent wrote it and submitted it as a candidate, and a person promoted it. The first capability to arrive through the loop rather than being designed in advance.
